biggest_catch: You earn 1,000 PayPal Rewards points per side — about $10 in cash-back value at PayPal's redemption rate — not $10 of plain cash, and only after your friend spends at least $5 within 30 days of joining.
catches: The reward is 1,000 PayPal Rewards points per side, not plain cash; points are worth 1 cent each when redeemed for cash back (1,000 points = $10 cash back) per PayPal's own offer terms, or usable at checkout.
Your friend must join PayPal via your invite, link a bank account or card, and spend at least $5 within 30 days of signup — otherwise neither side earns anything.
Cap: up to 10,000 points total (10 referrals).

Points are governed by the PayPal Rewards Program Agreement: your PayPal account must remain active — if inactive for 12 consecutive months, PayPal may reset your points to zero. Keep your account active to avoid losing points.
The offer may be canceled or modified at any time; amounts and terms differ by country (UK: £10 per side; Ireland: €10 per side; US: 1,000 points per side).

c1.evidence: PayPal — major global payments company; official paypal.com P2P referral terms page.

c2.evidence: Official PayPal US referral terms page states the 1,000-points-per-side reward, the $5-spend-in-30-days rule, and the 10,000-point cap.

c3.evidence: No fee to participate in the referral program.

c4.evidence: Official US page: 'When they spend at least $5 (within 30 days of signup), you both can earn 1,000 points' and 'When you invite ten of your friends to PayPal, you can earn up to 10,000 points.' Dollar value disclosed honestly as PayPal's own 1,000-points=$10-cash-back redemption rate.

eligibility: Referrer: a PayPal member with access to the referral program. Friend: a new user without a PayPal account who joins via the invite, links a bank account or card, and spends at least $5 within 30 days of signup. US program (other countries have their own amounts).
notes: Official PayPal US referral terms reviewed 2026-09-23. Third-party blogs disagree ($5/$5 cash, $10/$10 cash, 'up to $100 per referred user'); the official current US terms pay points, not cash: 1,000 points per side. The ~$10 value is from PayPal's own promotional redemption terms (1,000 PayPal Reward Points may be redeemed for $10 USD cash back). No PayPal referral routes exist in the catalog, so no duplication.
payout_quote: Official PayPal US referral terms: 'Get up to 10,000 points' — 'When you invite ten of your friends to PayPal, you can earn up to 10,000 points.' Qualifying action: 'When they spend at least $5 (within 30 days of signup), you both can earn 1,000 points.' Steps: '1. Invite a friend who doesn't have PayPal. 2. They join and link their bank account or card. 3. When they spend at least $5 (within 30 days of signup), you both can earn 1,000 points.' Points-to-cash: PayPal's own promotional terms state 'The 1,000 PayPal Reward Points, may be redeemed for $10 USD cash back, or use at checkout on any future purchases.'

s1.note: New PayPal users only via invite; friend links bank/card and spends $5+ in 30 days; up to 10 referrals (10,000 points).

s2.note: 1,000 PayPal Rewards points per side (~$10 cash-back value at 1 cent/point); no upfront fee.

s3.note: Friend must spend $5+ within 30 days of signup; offer can be canceled/modified at any time; points governed by the Rewards Agreement.

s4.note: '1,000 points' stated flatly for both sides; the US program pays points rather than cash (disclosed honestly).

s5.note: https://www.paypal.com/us/webapps/mpp/invite/terms — official PayPal US referral terms, loaded live 2026-09-23.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: invite friend, they join and link bank/card, they spend $5+ in 30 days, both get 1,000 points.

steps: Open PayPal and find your referral invite (Invite tab under profile or Offers/Deals).
Send your invite to a friend who doesn't have PayPal.
Your friend joins PayPal and links their bank account or card.
Your friend spends at least $5 within 30 days of signup.
You both receive 1,000 PayPal Rewards points each.
Redeem points for cash back (1,000 points = $10) or use them at PayPal checkout.
timing: Friend must spend $5+ within 30 days of signup; offer may be canceled or modified at any time.
